### 2. Custom AI Solutions (https://sarabjeetrattan.com/custom-ai-solutions)
- **Specialty**: Multi-agent systems, local LLMs, and custom AI architecture from scratch.
- **Key Capabilities**:

  - Quantized local LLM deployments with LM Studio for 100% private coding workflows.
  - Vector database integrations (pgvector, Supabase, Pinecone) for specialized RAG pipelines.
  - Proprietary web scraping engines with custom session management.

### 3. Custom Business Automation (https://sarabjeetrattan.com/custom-business-automation)
- **Specialty**: Bespoke operational workflows and zero-dependency integrations.
- **Key Capabilities**:

## Technical Insight Guides

1. **AI WordPress Plugin Development** (`/insights/ai-wordpress-plugin-development`):
   - Engineering bespoke PHP plugins without marketplace bloat, integrating OpenAI REST endpoints, and ensuring isolated database queries.
2. **Automated Search Console & GA4 Intelligence** (`/insights/automated-search-analytics-reporting`):
   - Daily automated search analytics ingestion, striking-distance keyword detection (Positions 5-20), and proactive executive alerting.
3. **Local LLMs with LM Studio** (`/insights/local-llm-lm-studio-workflow`):
   - Offline coding pipelines using quantized models (Qwen 2.5 Coder, DeepSeek-R1) with OpenAI-compatible endpoints and zero data leakage.
4. **Multi-Agent Orchestration from Scratch** (`/insights/multi-agent-orchestration-from-scratch`):
   - Designing deterministic agent loops with state machines, preventing runaway API loops, and enforcing HITL checkpoints.
5. **Custom Session Storage Engines** (`/insights/custom-session-storage-engines`):
   - High-velocity scraping architecture, session token pooling, IP rotation, and fast Redis/Supabase caching.
6. **Two-Way CRM Sync Engines** (`/insights/custom-crm-sync-engines`):
   - Stateful bi-directional synchronization, webhook retry engines, and deduplication logic without third-party connector limits.
7. **Enterprise Google Apps Script** (`/insights/google-sheets-apps-script-enterprise`):
   - Transforming Google Sheets into automated internal ERP machines with automated quotation generation and manager email approvals.
8. **Headless WordPress & React/Vite SSG** (`/insights/headless-wordpress-vite-architecture`):
   - Decoupled Headless WordPress with Vite Static Site Generation (SSG), achieving 100/100 Core Web Vitals and edge caching.

## Deep-Dive Case Studies

### 1. Lead OG (`/case-studies/lead-og`)
- **Specialty**: B2B AI Solutions / CRM Automation
- **Target Audience**: B2B Sales Teams & SDRs
- **Pain Points Solved**: Fragmented lead research, manual LinkedIn scraping, slow CRM synchronization.
- **Architecture**: Automated deep prospect research engine with a custom session caching storage engine for Freshsales synchronization.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Supabase, Tavily API, Custom Session Engine, Freshsales API.

### 2. LinkedIn Automation (`/case-studies/linked-in`)
- **Specialty**: Agentic Engineering / Content Automation
- **Target Audience**: Founders & Digital Publishers
- **Pain Points Solved**: Inconsistent publishing, manual topic research overhead.
- **Architecture**: Trello-driven CrewAI orchestration for topic research and high-fidelity content generation with an approve-to-publish workflow.
- **Tech Stack**: Python / CrewAI, Trello API, LinkedIn API, APScheduler.
